Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance

Class FiniteRadialAquiferInfluence

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance.FiniteRadialAquiferInfluence
public final class FiniteRadialAquiferInfluence extends Object
Prepared constant-terminal-rate response of a homogeneous, slightly compressible, sealed radial annulus.

The dimensionless inner radius is one, the initial pressure perturbation is zero and the imposed inner wall flux is unity. The outer wall has zero flux. For outer/inner radius ratios from 2 to 10, the response uses the infinite-domain spectrum before the outer reflection becomes significant and the finite radial diffusion eigenmodes thereafter. One immutable instance may be shared across histories at the same radius ratio.

Version:
1.0

    • evaluate

      double[] evaluate(double time)
      Evaluates pressure, derivative and pressure minus time times derivative. The third quantity is the directly evaluated Carter–Tracy denominator contribution, with the constant storage term canceled analytically.
      Parameters:
      time - finite nonnegative dimensionless time
      Returns:
      pressure, derivative and stable pressure excess

    • frequency

      private static double frequency(int mode, double radius, double width)
      Bisects the Neumann determinant in the disjoint Bessel-phase bracket for mode n. The order-one phase minus its argument decreases between -pi/2 and -3pi/4, so the root lies between n*pi/L and (n*pi+pi/4)/L.
      Parameters:
      mode - positive mode index
      radius - outer radius ratio
      width - dimensionless annular width
      Returns:
      positive radial frequency
